newsitem.title: UK: Virgin confirms interest in S.African market.
newsitem.headline: Virgin confirms interest in S.African market.

text.p: Richard Branson's Virgin Group confirmed on Monday that it was looking at opportunities in the South African financial services market but said any move was unlikely in the near term.
Asked about comments by life assurer Sanlam's managing director Desmond Smith that he believed Virgin might enter the market soon, a spokesman said it had no firm plans to do so yet.
"It's something we've said we're looking at but it's not even in the world of substance yet," said the Virgin spokesman.
"It's a market we will enter but whether we enter it in the next two or four years - it hasn't even got to that level of decision."
